question: Does certify/20t (certify/16e with the rival queries asked once at size N; no fixed-colour clique) decide more fresh noise-free 20-state worlds than certify/16e at the same conflict budget (B20 2000000, C20 50000), while staying sound, deterministic under a conflict-only stop, faithful, and equal to certify/16e at bound 16?

hypotheses.H1: certify/20t issues no WRONG certificate on 6 fresh 20-state worlds over two passes (12 records) or on 6 eps-0 16-state controls
hypotheses.H2: with a conflict-only stop on a 4-worker pool, the two certify/20t passes give byte-identical canonical records on 6/6 cases with 0 hard kills (053 showed this on 1 worker only)
hypotheses.H3: every certify/20t record is reproduced exactly by api_checks driving certify/20t observation by observation (run once)

Inferred risk declared pre-data: stop-check verdicts are equal by the padding argument, but M2 and so the experiments may differ, so a label can differ without any unsoundness; that is still a GCOMPAT20T54 failure
hypotheses.H5: certify/20t decides (ID+IDF) at least 2 of 6 fresh 20-state worlds and strictly more than certify/16e (API16E20, conflict-only stop) on the same 6 seeds; the exact count is reported, not predicted. Inferred risk declared pre-data from study-053's sealed API16E20 records: most budget went to the least-machine search and to SAT rivals at n_min; the per-size rival loop spent extra conflicts only when a smaller size was UNSAT first (12110002: four rounds with 17 UNSAT then 18 SAT, about 1.26M conflicts), so the gain may be small and H5 may fail

design.api: one new module brute/api/certify20t.py (certify/20t); no change to certify/16n (FREEZE_050), certify/16e (FREEZE_049), certify/16s (FREEZE_051) or any earlier module, which are imported only. certify/20t is certify/16e (A16: first-visit symmetry clauses, apartness clauses, the cube split on capped queries, chunked conflict resume; observe / propose / result interface, labels, K) with ONE change to the search: the rival queries ('future' and 'start') are asked once, on the size-N instance only, instead of at every size n_min..N. The least-machine search (sizes from n_lo upward) is unchanged. NO fixed-colour clique (amendment 054a; study-041). Soundness (Exact argument, checked by GCOMPAT20T54 and the CNF reference): a rival with n' <= N states consistent with the trace becomes an N-state rival by adding N - n' states that the trace never visits; first-visit numbers visited states 0..v-1 in first-visit order, so the padded machine satisfies the first-visit and apartness clauses and differs from M1 on the same word; hence the size-N rival query is UNSAT iff every size n_min..N rival query is UNSAT, and a SAT answer is a rival with at most N states. Verdicts of each stop check are unchanged; the rival model M2 (and so the next experiment word) may differ. The conflict-only stop is kept: wall guards record walls and never change a result; hard job kill at 900 s. The exact readings are fixed in pre-run deviation #181 before the freeze.

amendment_reason: Plan 054 design.api (c) fixes a greedy max clique of pairwise-apart nodes to colours 0..m-1. That is the same mechanism as scalesearch15's Pool15/Inc15 (greedy_clique over apart trace positions, each clique member fixed to its own colour), which the v0.38.0 encoding audit (study BRUTE-0380-ENCODING-AUDIT-041; GATES_041 at 40d1484; deviations #154 and #155) isolated as encaudit16 variant E2. GAUD_loc passed with component 'fixed-colour clique': E2 alone reproduced the GINC15 decision loss in 3/3 repeats while E1 (apartness clauses, no colours) matched E0 (A14) in 3/3; E2 also decided 28/30 sealed 039 A14 decisions (E0 and E1 30/30) and cost a mean per-trace call-wall ratio of 4.18 [2.53, 6.46] against E0 (E1: 1.11 [1.01, 1.24]) (Observed, study-041). A16 (v0.39.0, brute/scalesearch16, deviation #157) therefore dropped the fixed colours and kept first-visit symmetry plus apartness. Plan 054's clique is a tree-node clique rather than a trace-position clique, but in Brute's active setting there is no reset: every experiment word is appended to the one trace, so the observation tree of the trace is a single path whose nodes are exactly the trace positions. The plan's tree colouring (a) and tree apartness (b) are then A16's position encoding x[t][q] and A16's apartness clauses, and (c) is E2's fixed-colour clique (Exact by construction; the harm is Observed in study-041). Under the user's instruction (2026-10-31 16:50 EDT) the clique is dropped.
